raw_text: Sources in Indian defence cyber circles confirm Lazarus Group malware detected at Kudankulam Nuclear Power Plant. The intrusion targeted administrative systems including HR databases and procurement portals. Critical OT systems on the operational side are air-gapped and were not compromised. DAE has ordered a full security audit of all nuclear installations nationwide.
clean_text: Defence cyber sources confirm Lazarus malware at Kudankulam targeting admin HR and procurement systems. OT air-gapped and secure. DAE ordered nationwide nuclear security audit.
